data.long_meaning: Pravendra is derived from the Sanskrit word Praveñdrā, meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. This name is rich in meaning and symbolism, reflecting the strength and wisdom of the divine. It is a powerful and evocative name, ideal for a child who is destined for great things. The name Pravendra carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pravendra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Pravendra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pravendra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
